name: Dracula's Kiss, Spellbound by a Doppelganger
original_name: Dracula's Kiss, Spellbound by a Doppelganger
overview: After her boyfriend cheats on her, Flora meets the enigmatic Vittorio and impulsively marries him for revenge. Little does she know, he's a dangerous vampire, with a photo in his study of a woman identical to her from 80 years ago.
